collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A child carves a message on a piece of driftwood addressed to a child far away.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), a child, carves a message on a piece of driftwood addressed to "a child far away."

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The child keeps it under their mat and adds a new line each year.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The child reads it to a friend, who wants to write one too.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The child watches it drift out past the reef, hoping someone finds it.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: An elder reminds them that a reply might never come, and the child decides that is all right.

b2__fx.name: Outcome B2
b2__fx.text: It washes back ashore the next morning, and the child laughs and tries again another day.

b2__text.name: Outcome B2
b2__text.text: It washes back ashore the next morning, and the child laughs and tries again another day.

c1__fx.name: Outcome C1
c1__fx.text: The child imagines a distant child carving an answer, and smiles.
